name: SkyGuard
author: mvgoodwin78
description: Blacks out moving-head light output when aircraft are within a set radius, using a local ADS-B receiver or online flight data. If you use online data, your show's location and search radius go to the provider you choose (opendata.adsb.fi or api.adsb.lol). For personal use only: it does nothing until you confirm that. A typed address goes to nominatim.openstreetmap.org only when you press Look up.

privacy.summary: Blacks out moving heads when aircraft are near. It can send your show's location to an online flight data service, and a typed address to OpenStreetMap when you press Look up.

sends.why: to find nearby aircraft, when this is the online provider in use

privacy.other: For personal use only; it does nothing until you confirm that. Runs a background program while FPP runs, and forces the dimmer and shutter channels you list to their off values during a blackout. Anyone who can reach FPP can read this plugin's status, including your show's location, can change its settings including the saved location and fixture list, can ask it to test a receiver or online provider or look up an address, and can run its Enable, Disable and Test Trigger commands. Uninstalling removes its saved data.
